senses.gloss: f. (v. סַנְיָא II) evil habit, (by way of angry antiphrasis) practice, virtue.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 50:4">Gen. R. s. 50</cite> <he>אוף הדא ס׳ בישא וכ׳</he> (Ar. ed. Koh. <cite ref="O01243"><he>סניתא</he></cite>) wilt thou introduce also this bad practice (another of your noble virtues)?; Yalk. ib. 84 <he>הדין סויניתא</he> (corr. acc.). [Ar. refers to συνήθεια.]
